reversal.name: Reversed condition
reversal.desc: Flips the logic: treats what's needed as a guarantee, or the reverse.

out_of_scope.name: Out of scope
out_of_scope.desc: Brings in something the argument or passage never addresses.

too_strong.name: Too strong
too_strong.desc: Goes further than the evidence supports (all, never, only).

too_weak.name: Too weak
too_weak.desc: True or relevant, but not strong enough to do the job.

wrong_direction.name: Wrong direction
wrong_direction.desc: Does the opposite of what the question asks.

restates_premise.name: Restates a premise
restates_premise.desc: Repeats evidence instead of doing the question's task.

irrelevant_comparison.name: Irrelevant comparison
irrelevant_comparison.desc: Compares groups or things the argument doesn't depend on.

doesnt_differentiate.name: Doesn't separate the groups
doesnt_differentiate.desc: Affects both sides equally, so it can't explain a difference.

not_present.name: Not in the argument
not_present.desc: Describes a flaw or move the argument doesn't actually make.

half_right.name: Half right
half_right.desc: Starts correctly, then adds a part that's wrong or unsupported.

deepens.name: Deepens the puzzle
deepens.desc: Makes the discrepancy harder to explain, not easier.

contradicts.name: Contradicts the text
contradicts.desc: Conflicts with something the stimulus or passage states.

unsupported.name: Could be true
unsupported.desc: Might be true, but nothing in the text proves it.

too_narrow.name: Too narrow
too_narrow.desc: Covers one detail or paragraph, not the whole passage.

wrong_viewpoint.name: Wrong viewpoint
wrong_viewpoint.desc: Gives a view held by someone other than the one asked about.

distortion.name: Distortion
distortion.desc: Uses the passage's words but twists what they mean.

sign_flip.name: Flipped sign
sign_flip.desc: Right idea, wrong direction or sign (+/−, increase/decrease).

power_of_ten.name: Unit or power-of-10 slip
power_of_ten.desc: Dropped a unit conversion or an order of magnitude.

lookalike.name: Look-alike concept
lookalike.desc: Confuses a similar-sounding concept, formula or structure.

skipped_step.name: Skipped step
skipped_step.desc: Stops one step short of the full calculation.

misread_data.name: Misread the data
misread_data.desc: Pulls the wrong value from a table, graph or condition.

true_irrelevant.name: True but irrelevant
true_irrelevant.desc: A correct statement that doesn't answer this question.

false_fact.name: Factually wrong
false_fact.desc: States something that isn't true about the science.

overreach.name: Overreach
overreach.desc: Claims more than the data or study design can show.
